newsitem.title: CANADA: Epic Data sees Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Epic Data sees Q1 loss.

text.p: Epic Data International Inc said on Monday it expected to post a net loss of between C$1.1 million and C$1.3 million, or C$0.18 to C$0.21 per share, for its first quarter ending December 31.

"Compared to the first quarter of last year, revenue growth continues to be strong, however, increasing selling and administrative costs and lower than anticipated gross profit increases have resulted in a substantial loss," president and chairman Barclay Isherwood said in a statement.
Epic Data expects to release its first quarter results within the next three weeks.
